findings.evidence: `Exponent.lean:66` defines `theorem aut_nontrivial`; its proof is only `(galoisGroupEquiv hroot hindep).toEquiv.nontrivial`, while `Galois/Group.lean:212` defines `galoisGroupEquiv` and `Galois/Group.lean:247` already stores the cardinality reading of that equivalence.
findings.fix: Move `aut_nontrivial` to `TauCeti/NumberTheory/Multiquadratic/Galois/Group.lean` near `galoisGroupEquiv`/`card_aut_adjoin_range`, and leave `Exponent.lean` importing `Galois.Group` for `aut_exponent_eq_two`.
findings.issue: `aut_nontrivial` is not exponent material; it is the basic nontriviality consequence of `galoisGroupEquiv`, so users of `Galois.Group` would miss it unless they import the exponent file.

summary: One non-exponent declaration is placed in the new exponent file even though it is basic API for the existing Galois-group equivalence. The imports themselves are specific and justified.
